tokens.name: White
tokens.usage: Background

tokens.name: Black
tokens.usage: Text

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App, preview and panel background (.cp-app, .cp-preview, .panel); download button fill; slider thumb ring (4px border).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All control text on `surface` and `input-bg`: input values, toggle/checkbox labels, snippet code, dimension label. 19.6:1 on surface, 18:1 on input-bg.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Field labels (.field-label), input icons/prefix letters, opacity % suffix. Resolves to about #808080 on surface: 3.9:1, and 3.6:1 on input-bg, below 4.5:1 for 9–11px text. Kept exact from source; flagged.

tokens.name: input-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of every 24px control (.input-wrap, slider value box), slider track, snippet textarea, cubic-bézier editor ground, toggle knob.

tokens.name: focus-border
tokens.usage: 1px border on .input-wrap:focus-within and 1px focus-visible outline on toggle/checkbox rows. 2.7:1 on surface, below the 3:1 focus-ring floor; kept exact, flagged.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Outer border of .cp-app and the panel's left (mobile: top) border.

tokens.name: border-button
tokens.usage: Border of the Snippet Output download button.

tokens.name: hover-fill
tokens.usage: Download button hover background.

tokens.name: hover-overlay
tokens.usage: Chevron hover wash inside a dimension control.

tokens.name: control-fill
tokens.usage: Active/selected state: slider fill and thumb, toggle track when on, checked/indeterminate checkbox box.

tokens.name: control-fill-off
tokens.usage: Toggle track when off.

tokens.name: checkbox-border
tokens.usage: 2px border of an unchecked checkbox box.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Swatch inset ring, dropdown menu border, color-preview border.

tokens.name: divider-line
tokens.usage: Panel divider line (.panel-divider__line); slider thumb outer ring.

tokens.name: tick-mark
tokens.usage: 3×3px tick marks on a Slider Tick track.

tokens.name: menu-bg
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus (dimension menu, option selector) — the kit's menus are black.

tokens.name: menu-text
tokens.usage: Menu option text on `menu-bg` (21:1).

tokens.name: menu-item-active
tokens.usage: Hovered/active menu option on `menu-bg`.

tokens.name: bezier-handle
tokens.usage: Cubic-bézier handle lines and handle strokes — the kit's only chromatic colour.

tokens.name: bezier-handle-focus
tokens.usage: Cubic-bézier handle stroke when focused.

tokens.name: bezier-curve
tokens.usage: Cubic-bézier curve stroke (3px) and guide lines (40% opacity).

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Every control value and row label: inputs, toggles, checkboxes, menus, buttons. Colour `ink`.

styles.name: field-label
styles.usage: Field labels above a control row (.field-label, slider labels). Colour `ink-muted`, capitalized.

styles.name: preview-box
styles.usage: Default text in the preview area (.cp-preview-box).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Snippet Output textarea only. DM Mono is used nowhere else.

spacing.note: Exact values from base.css and component CSS; no grid snapping.

tokens.name: field-padding-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of every .field, slider field and divider (0 16px).

tokens.name: field-gap
tokens.usage: Bottom margin between fields; panel vertical padding.

tokens.name: row-gap
tokens.usage: Gap inside .row, between stacked rows, label → control, and between slider value and track.

tokens.name: input-inset
tokens.usage: Text inset inside an .input-wrap with no icon; chevron and suffix padding.

tokens.name: menu-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a dimension control and its menu; divider vertical padding.

tokens.name: menu-padding
tokens.usage: Inner padding of dropdown menus; toggle track padding.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Inputs, slider track and fill, snippet textarea, buttons, menu options, colour preview.

tokens.name: radius-menu
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus; toggle track and knob.

tokens.name: radius-app
tokens.usage: Outer corner of .cp-app (0 in fullscreen).

tokens.name: radius-checkbox
tokens.usage: Checkbox box.

tokens.name: radius-swatch
tokens.usage: 14px colour swatch in Color Input.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Slider thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: Slider thumb outline.

tokens.name: shadow-swatch
tokens.usage: Inner ring on the Color Input swatch.

size.note: Fixed dimensions the kit's layout depends on.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Control panel sidebar width (240px field + 1px border). Changing it means updating all field CSS.

tokens.name: field-width
tokens.usage: Width of every field, slider field and divider.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of every input, toggle/checkbox row, menu option and button.

tokens.name: slider-track-width
tokens.usage: Slider track width beside the value box.

tokens.name: slider-track-height
tokens.usage: Slider track height; toggle track height.

tokens.name: slider-thumb-size
tokens.usage: Slider thumb diameter including its 4px white ring.
